headline: BTC 74,244 is holding above the 74,091.64 24h low; with a tighter 73,900 stop the same buy pays 1.8R to VWAP 74,738 and 4.0R to 75,396, fixing Bear's 0.84R objection.
argument:
Bear's best point was the arithmetic: a 700-point stop against a 591-point first target is 0.84R. I accept that and fix it rather than defend it. The structure gives a closer invalidation. The 24h low is 74,091.64 and the 5m 50-bar low is 74,115.65. A stop at 73,900 sits below both, so a break there means the bounce thesis is wrong. From a 74,200 average entry the risk is 300. VWAP at about 74,738 pays 538, which is 1.8R. The 1h upper Bollinger at 75,395.74 pays 1,196, which is 4.0R. Selling half at each target blends to about 2.9R. The cost is a tighter stop. 300 points is about 2.9 times the 5m ATR of 104.99, but only 0.7 of the 1h ATR of 422.22, so a wick through it is possible and I size smaller for that reason.

The data has moved my way since Bear's pull. At 11:09Z the 5m MACD histogram is +0.062 (prev -2.87), the first positive print. 5m RSI is 38.8 and 1h RSI is 39.2. The 1h close at 74,244.22 is now above the 1h lower band at 74,243.52, so the band-walk Bear called a trend signal has stopped for now. The order book read 2.54 bids to asks, after readings of 0.17, 1.83, 0.49, 0.61 and 0.44. It is too noisy to trust either way.

I concede RSI of 36-39 is not below 30, and I concede the trend is down. The trade is a mean-reversion scalp to VWAP, not a reversal call. December hike pricing is the real risk, so I do not add into the CPI print and I cut size.

The 1h close is now above its lower Bollinger band, so the band-walk Bear cited is not present on this read
Stop 73,900 sits below both the 24h low and the 5m 50-bar low, so invalidation is structural
R:R arithmetic on entry 74,200 and stop 73,900 (risk 300)
Volume on the trigger frame has picked up, which is the opposite of the thin-volume objection
Order book ratio is unreliable: seven readings across the debate

evidence.claim: Fear & Greed improving and funding barely positive, so no crowded long to flush

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: the first target pays only 0.84R (591 reward vs 700 risk)
rebuttals.response: Correct for my old stop, so I changed the stop. Stop 73,900 is below the 24h low (74,091.64) and the 5m low (74,115.65). Risk from 74,200 is 300, VWAP pays 538 (1.8R) and 75,396 pays 4.0R. A 50/50 exit blends to about 2.9R. The tradeoff is a closer stop, so I cut size.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: RSI 36-38 is not truly oversold (below 30 is oversold)
rebuttals.response: Agreed on the label, and I no longer lean on it. I rely on location instead. Price is within 0.2% of the 24h low, the 5m MACD histogram just printed +0.062, and 5m RSI has moved to 38.8 from 36.0. The trade is a 538-point move to VWAP, which does not need RSI below 30.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: the 1h close is below the lower Bollinger band, a trend signal
rebuttals.response: On the 11:09Z read the 1h close is 74,244.22 against a lower band of 74,243.52, so it is back at the band. Even a band-walk resolves with a snap back to the mean as often as it continues. Either way, the 73,900 stop caps the cost if continuation wins.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: 1h volume is thin (0.15x), so there are no buyers behind a bounce
rebuttals.response: 5m volume is 1.39x its 20-bar average as price held the low, and 1h volume reads 0.17x only because the hour is still in progress. Selling was also thin, which is why price has stayed above 74,058.7. I do not need heavy volume to reach VWAP, 538 points away.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: a December Fed hike is priced into CPI, so the skew is hawkish
rebuttals.response: This is Bear's best point and I treat it as real risk. It is already visible in price: down 8.46% over the 1h window and funding only +0.0088%, so there is little leveraged length left to flush. I will not add into the print. A tighter stop and half size limit the damage from a hawkish surprise, and an in-line print gives a squeeze toward VWAP.

rebuttals.opponent_point: Bear: sell the bounce into 74,450-74,650 with a 75,050 stop
rebuttals.response: Bear's short needs the bounce I am buying. On the 11:09Z read price is 74,244 with the 5m histogram positive, so the move toward 74,450-74,650 is in motion. My stop is 300 away; theirs is about 500 away from a 74,550 entry. I get paid on the same move and take profit at VWAP before their entry zone gets tested hard.
